description: 只改变从零训练轮数与完整cosine日程；十二行全部按最终轮冻结并自动clean测试
authorization: 用户明确要求：启动E30压缩三行和E20压缩三行和E40压缩三行；再加一个E10压缩三行；沿用已授权的epoch开发clean比较

data.representation: equalized=1; center crop/pad 256; per-packet complex RMS; center=False; fs=25MHz

roles.U_use: disabled; U_s IQ and labels are not iterated or trained

data.split_id: inherited deterministic physical source roles (historical protocol label 392005)
data.support_query_ref: No support adaptation; fixed clean capsule after each row freeze
data.train_ratio_definition: rho_label=L_s/(L_s+U_s)=0.1 unchanged; U_s TX truth never visible
data.diagnostic_access: L only for CE; U iteration/teacher/satellite disabled; V monitoring only

permissions.claim_scope: exposed development benchmark; not blind test

explicit_user_exception.verbatim: 看测试集验证，源域验证不需要看，测试集性能不下降超过0.3
explicit_user_exception.criterion: three-seed clean mean minus fixed original E200 >= -0.003

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: source role IDs and fresh model initialization checked at runtime
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: no checkpoint inheritance; E200 only reused fixed predictions for comparison
checkpoint.selection_rule: fixed final E10/E20/E30/E40; every predeclared row tested

execution.gpu_policy: <=2 total CUDA/reserved processes per GPU including other owners; >=12000MB free; 8-card pool
execution.stop_rule: technical failure stops pending; healthy rows continue; no automatic retry or output overwrite
